scope: AKMM Chapter 2 (pp. 43-69): growth accounting (2.1)-(2.3) in continuous time, the accumulation equation (2.4) and balanced paths, the detrended Solow map via EconomicGrowth, the aggregation box, the Euler equation and CRRA (2.5) with its log limit, and KPR and Boppart-Krusell preferences on balanced paths.
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 2
